Job Advertisement: Automotive Electrician
Company Name: N K Transport AUS Pty Ltd
Location: Pinkenba QLD 4008
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum

About the Company
N K Transport AUS Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based transport and logistics company providing courier, interstate freight, specialised transportation and logistics solutions across Australia. With a modern fleet, an in-house mechanical workshop and a strong commitment to reliability, safety and operational efficiency, the company delivers tailored transport services to a diverse range of commercial clients.

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Automotive Electrician to join our workshop team in Pinkenba, Queensland. The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining and installing electrical and electronic systems across the company's fleet of commercial vehicles and transport equipment to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operations.

Key Responsibilities
• Diagnose faults in electrical and electronic systems using specialised diagnostic equipment and testing instruments.
• Test, repair and replace electrical components including sensors, switches, relays, control modules and associated wiring.
• Install and maintain electronic accessories such as GPS tracking systems, reversing cameras, telematics, communication equipment and safety devices.
• Ensure all electrical repairs and installations comply with manufacturer specifications, workplace safety requirements and relevant Australian standards.
• Maintain accurate service records and communicate repair requirements with workshop supervisors and maintenance personnel.
• Inspect electrical systems to identify defects and perform preventative maintenance to minimise vehicle downtime.
• Install, repair and maintain vehicle wiring, lighting systems, alternators, starter motors, batteries and charging systems.
• Read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams, circuit schematics and technical service information to complete repairs accurately.

Skills and Experience
• AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV in Automotive Electrical Technology, or an equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of one (1) year of relevant full-time work experience as an Automotive Electrician.
• Strong knowledge of automotive electrical systems, electronic diagnostics and fault-finding techniques.
• Experience working on commercial vehicles, vans or light and heavy transport fleets will be highly regarded.
• Ability to interpret wiring diagrams and technical manuals.
• Proficiency in using automotive diagnostic equipment, electrical testing instruments and workshop tools.
• Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and quality workmanship.

Why Join Our Team
• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
• Stable full-time employment with opportunities for long-term career growth.
• Supportive and professional team environment.
• Modern workshop equipped with quality diagnostic equipment and tools.
• Opportunity to work on a diverse fleet of commercial transport vehicles within a growing logistics business.

How to Apply
If you meet the above qualifications and are looking to build your career with a growing transport and logistics company, please submit your resume outlining your skills,
qualifications and relevant experience. We welcome applications from motivated and experienced Automotive Electricians who are committed to delivering quality workmanship and maintaining the highest standards of vehicle safety and reliability.

Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD is seeking a skilled and experienced Automotive Electrician to join our team in Maidstone, Victoria. This is a full-time position that offers an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic automotive service environment. As an Automotive Electrician, you will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing and maintaining electrical systems in vehicles, ensuring that all work meets safety standards and exceeds customer expectations. This role is integral to our operations, allowing us to deliver high-quality electrical services to our valued clients.
Key responsibilities:
•     Using test equipment to locate electrical and electronic malfunctions.
•     Dismantling and removing electrical and electronic assemblies and components.
•     Installing electrical equipment and electronic components in motor vehicles.
•     Connecting power-operated vehicle equipment and accessories to power supply.
•     Adjusting engine control systems and timing.
•     Testing and replacing defective alternators, generators, voltage regulators and starter motors.
•     Repairing and replacing faulty ignition and electrical wiring.
•     Replacing defective parts such as fuses, lamps and switches.
Qualifications:
•     Certificate III in Automotive Electrical Technology or equivalent qualification.
•     Current Driver Licence.
•     Air Conditioning Handling Licence (preferred but not essential).
Experience:
•     Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as an Automotive Electrician.
•     Experience diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining automotive electrical and electronic systems.
•     Experience working with a wide range of vehicle makes and models.
Skills:
•     Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills.
•     Ability to repair and maintain vehicle electrical and electronic systems.
•     Knowledge of wiring systems, batteries, charging systems, starters, lighting, and electronic control systems.
•     Ability to use diagnostic equipment and technical manuals.
•     Basic knowledge of Roadworthy Certificate (RWC) inspection requirements and vehicle safety standards.
•     Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
•     Good communication and customer service skills.
•     Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•     Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

What we offer:
At Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD, we value our employees and are committed to providing a rewarding work environment. We offer competitive remuneration reflecting your skills and experience, ongoing professional development opportunities to keep you current with industry advancements, and a supportive team culture where your expertise is recognised and valued. We provide a safe, well-equipped workshop environment with modern diagnostic tools and equipment to support your work. We also offer flexible working arrangements where possible and encourage a healthy work-life balance. Our team-focused approach means you'll collaborate with experienced technicians and have access to mentorship and training to further develop your career.

About us:
Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD is an automotive repair workshop located in Maidstone, Victoria. The company provides a wide range of automotive services, including mechanical repairs, vehicle servicing, diagnostics, and electrical fault diagnosis. Committed to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, the business delivers reliable automotive solutions to both private and commercial clients.
